issue_context.title: Tankerkoenig config flow: How to set stations via ID?
issue_context.body:
### The problem

With the change to config flow, how can I change/edit/add now stations via ID as before?

e.g. from the past

```
tankerkoenig:
  fuel_types:
    - "diesel"
  stations:
    - 8c0ba54b-a30b-45cb-a49a-798681d0783c
    - 005056ba-7cb6-1ed2-bceb-a5c77b480d41
```

I don't want and cannot use radius.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.3.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

tankerkoenig

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tankerkoenig/

comments:
Hey there @guillempages, @mib1185, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`tankerkoenig`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L1016) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

It is not possible to add stations by id anymore. But you can search for the stations you want on the map with a very small radius, and then select only the station you want.

You can add more than one instance of the integration, with different locations every time, if you want stations that are far away from each other.

Ah, now I have seen that there is a selection screen on the second page after search. First I missed the location mark, because of my theme (this one is white on white in most of custom themes).

But I see several problems with the new approach nevertheless.

1. Radius is only possible till 25km, which is too low in standard urban working distances, and if you want to stay with one integration (see 3.). 50 would be more realistic.

2. The stations are only displayed with street and n°, but not with city, which makes it harder than needed to find the right once.

3. If you have to add more integrations, I assume that there is more overhead in the storage and more effort and calls, if I want to have different update times, which have been removed as well. So disabling per integration and parallel integrations per integration, etc.

Would be great of at least 1. would be improved, but an option to add single stations per ID was really fine in the past.

Hi @emufan 

the radius is limited to 25km by the used [API](https://creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de/), so it cannot be increased from HA side. Further, don't worry about any kind of storage overhead, when adding multiple tankerkoenig entries for different regions (_location + radius_).

Last but not least, with implementing the UI based configuration approach, also a new rule has been enforced, that we do not allow configuring the scan interval anymore, but set a sane default (_here 30min_).
If you still want to have a different update interval, you can disable the polling of the integration and create an own automation, which uses the [`homeassistant.update_entity`](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homeassistant/#service-homeassistantupdate_entity) service and triggers based on your own needs.

For any other kind of questions, feature requests or suggestions, please use our support channels [chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat/) and [forum](https://community.home-assistant.io/), since we use GitHub for tracking issues.

Thanks! 👍

Hey, is it not possible to implement the option to add different station-id's by UI?

They are along a "line" on my way to my working place.
In the past it was very useful, to add the interessent stations via station-id.

I am new in this and for me the UI installation is quit simple.
Fill in your Ort (actually i have no idea for what reason).
Fill in your API key.
You can move the location pin on the small map (with a dark theme hard to see).
And from that pin (lets say an place you want to tank) search within a radius.

On the second page you can select multiple the gas stations. 

Finish setup and it's done.

Afterwards i haven't find out how to change the gas stations. So i deleted the Integration and started over again with the desired selection.

I've deleted my comment, because I was too fast and simply disappointed.

After giving it a proper try, I have to admit that adding a second instance is not as problematic as it seemed before. You have to know that you have to drag this maker, but after I've figured that out, it worked nicely. Still the issue concerning the interval remains.

I'm also interested in how to adding a station afterwards.
For example here a new station opened, another closed,
do i really have to remove and reinstall the integration for each change?

Thanks

Hi,

just to give you an update here - i'm currently very busy in "real life", so please be a bit more patient.

---

> * stations: select only the gas stations I wanted

You can select the stations, when adding the integration. During import of the YAML configuration, all stations in radius + all manual defined stations will be added.
Further I'll add a possibility soon, so that the stations can later be managed via integrations option from the UI.

> * scan_interval:

I already explained the cause of this change and a possible solution in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/69693#issuecomment-1093996860

> * show on map: (currently not used)

This option is still there, you will find it in the integration options.

---

regards,
Michael
